notes: All figures come from LVMH's 2024 Universal Registration Document, filed with the AMF. LVMH reports three single countries (France, United States, Japan), which are in countries, and three remainder regions (Europe excl. France, Asia excl. Japan, Other markets), whose country lists the filing does not define. Each table is its own row, so France, the U.S. and Japan appear three times (stores, employees, operating investments) with different metric keys. The investment table calls the last region 'Other countries', not 'Other markets', and the name is kept as filed. The workforce total (215,637, including temporary and non-guaranteed-hours contracts) differs from the 200,518 headcount on the site, which is a different measure. Store counts include Sephora (2,175 stores). The URD has no U.S. state breakdown, and no taxes-by-country table: a search for 'country-by-country', 'taxes paid' and 'tax contribution' found nothing. A separate LVMH tax report was not checked. Vineyard areas are in hectares and appear only in site descriptions. Some site quotes are shortened to text that is contiguous in the PDF's two-column layout.
